_doc: The proof's PRIMITIVE numbers (Wilson 11-12). Derived thresholds are computed by model/proof_constants.py, never stored. Lean pins each primitive and each derivation with an rfl lemma (Params.lean, ProofConstants section); gate_lean_build checks this file against them. run_rean_floor checks rean_* against the RTL. The clock gate's USB rows, the image admissibility gate and the compiler read the derived values.
_certified: usb_other_R is CERTIFIED, not a primitive: written by model/gen_cert_constants.py from lane_cert's certificate on test/usbdev.py (RespSpan.wb_close_span, b'); gate_lane_cert checks it is current. Wilson 11-14.
